dialogues.speaker: Observe the Villa Guiztli guests
dialogues.text: Guests who've come all the way from Villa Guiztli. So far, they're getting along quite peacefully.

dialogues.speaker: Observe the Villa Guiztli guests
dialogues.text: No one's touched the valuable Soothing Salve. It's a gift for the hero who saved Villa Guiztli.
